heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.content:
Article130

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
For leave to appeal as a pauper—
(a)to the High Court;
Period of limitationSixty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of decree appealed from.



(b)to any other court.
Period of limitationThirty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of decree appealed from.
